summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting poll results from an extraordinary general meeting and class meetings held on May 20, 2026. Shareholders approved special resolutions to increase authorized share capital, vary voting rights of Class B shares to 100 votes per share, adopt amended articles, and issue 5 million Class B shares to Ping Shiang Business Ltd for US$200. These are routine corporate governance matters—capital structure changes and share issuance to an affiliate. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is involved. This filing does not constitute a special situation; it is a standard post-meeting report.
